steps.title: South Landing
steps.why: Arrive at the spawn beacon. Across the bay the ice groans; a lantern burns in the village.

steps.title: Ferryman's Village
steps.why: Sigrun, the last lamp-keeper: the ice took the ferry, the drowned bell tolls each night and the ice cracks a little more. The old beacons kept the lanes safe. Light them.

steps.title: The Old Quarry
steps.why: The beacon oil is stored in the quarry, and ice crawlers nest in the pit. First fight.

steps.title: The Old Ferry Line
steps.why: Grab the old ferry rope: holding it is the only safe way over unlit ice, and cracks spread around you as you haul across. The hoverboard won't run on ice.

steps.title: Signal Tower · Beacon 1
steps.why: Relight the brazier: the SOUTH LANE glows across the bay. Sigrun's sled-board waits at the tower: fast, but it rides lit lanes only.

steps.title: Cliff Overlook
steps.why: Survey the bay: the two dark beacons, the spire and the frozen ferry wreck are marked on your map and minimap. The goal, revealed.

steps.title: Glacier Mouth
steps.why: Climb onto the glacier: a switchback trail and rope ladders up the ice cliff, crevasses to jump.

steps.title: The Glacier Beacon · Beacon 2
steps.why: Light the cairn fire on the ice field: the NORTH-EAST LANE glows to the lighthouse. The bell's clapper lies frozen in a crevasse; a crawler queen guards it.

steps.title: The Lighthouse · Beacon 3
steps.why: Sled the north-east lane, climb the spiral stair, relight the lamp: the WEST LANE glows, and the beam sweeps the bay and shows the drowned streets around the spire.

steps.title: The Ice Cave
steps.why: Down the west lane, a hidden crack into the glacier wall: the frozen chapel and its bell rope.

steps.title: The Drowned Spire
steps.why: All three lanes lit, the CENTRE LANE opens. Hang the clapper and the rope, ring the drowned bell: the Bellkeeper breaks the ice. Boss fight on the ring of cracked ice.

steps.title: Home
steps.why: The bell is silent; the ice holds. Sigrun relights the ferry lantern.

laneStages.title: STAGE 1 · THE SOUTH LANE
laneStages.text: The ice is thin and dark. Sigrun gives the harpoon; oil from the crawler-filled quarry; a tense walk along the old ferry rope; the signal tower burns and the south lane glows. The sled-board makes the bay fast.

laneStages.title: STAGE 2 · THE NORTH-EAST LANE
laneStages.text: From the east shore the overlook shows the goal. Climb onto the glacier, cross crevasses, light the cairn fire; take the clapper from the crawler queen. The lane to the lighthouse glows.

laneStages.title: STAGE 3 · THE WEST LANE
laneStages.text: Relight the lighthouse: its beam sweeps the bay, shows the drowned streets and the keepsakes, and lights the west lane to the ice cave, where the bell rope hangs in a frozen chapel.

laneStages.title: FINALE · THE CENTRE LANE
laneStages.text: Three beacons burn; the centre lane opens to the spire. Ring the bell with its clapper and rope: the Bellkeeper breaks the ice. The fight circles the cathedral spire on a ring of cracked ice; the lit lanes are safe ground.

laneStages.title: WHY THE PLAYER GOES
laneStages.text: Every stage ends with a new lit lane you can see from far away: the next goal is always in sight, and the bay opens like a map being drawn.

laneStages.title: THE ANTAGONIST
laneStages.text: The Bellkeeper, coiled round the drowned church, tolls the bell each night to crack the ice and take the village. Ringing the bell yourself, with its own clapper and rope, calls it up to fight.

side.title: Hot Spring · The Hunter
side.text: Old Brann camps at the spring: bring 3 crawler shells, get a fur cloak (warmth: slower cold drain on the ice).

side.title: The Lost Ferry
side.text: The ferry is frozen under the north mouth. Seen only in the lighthouse beam; dig out the ferryman's lantern (wider light).

side.title: The Quarry Ledger
side.text: Pages of the quarry ledger in the pit tell how the church was drowned for its stone.

side.title: Feat · Bay Run
side.text: The south lane on the sled-board under 60 s.

side.title: Feat · No Fall
side.text: Light all three beacons without breaking through the ice.

side.title: Keepsakes ×8
side.text: Drowned keepsakes in the ice round the spire, lit only by the lighthouse beam.

side.title: Cache
side.text: A frozen cache under the overlook ledge (a rope down).

side.title: Happening · The Bell
side.text: At night the bell tolls under the ice: rings of cracks spread from the spire.

side.title: Happening · The Crack
side.text: A crack races across the bay: unlit lanes break.

side.title: Ice Crawlers
side.text: Quarry pit, glacier crevasses (and the queen).

Thin ice: the mask, the crack timer, fall-through and respawn
The rope grab: attach to a rope line, move along it, safe over thin ice

Beacons light lanes: a world-state flag lights a lane's lanterns and flips its thin-ice cells to safe
The sled-board: fast, lit lanes only
The survey: marks map and minimap pins
The lighthouse beam reveal (the drowned streets, the keepsakes, the lost ferry)
The aurora sky shader; the see-through ice over the drowned village

02-village.note: "the lighthouse flipped … rendering a lighthouse to the right of the spire when the lighthouse is to the left of the spire in the first image. So that's not internally consistent."

03-lighthouse.note: "the stairs going up the lighthouse are completely junk"; "some kind of village on the far edge … I don't know where that village exists".

05-spire.note: "the spire needs to be bigger … a boss arena, nice and bigger"; under the ice it shows "a reflection" instead of the rest of the spire.

06-cave.note: "fantastic"; but no buildings under the ice there: "the village under the ice should only be near the boss".

07-overlook.note: "a gigantic village underneath the ice … a lot of copy pasta … way too big"; the spire bigger.

10-glacier.note: "doesn't look particularly impressive … a lot more thought needs to go into the glacier mouth".

11-spring.note: "can be bigger … it looks like super tiny".
